suggested_experiment_name: CIBER (TeV gamma-ray transparency / axion-photon oscillation, CIBER-only contour)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 5
notes: This is a phenomenological paper by Kohri & Kodama (arXiv:1704.05189), not an experimental exclusion. It identifies an ALLOWED/preferred region in the (ma, g_agamma) plane (ma ~ 7e-10 to 5e-8 eV, g_agamma ~ 1.5e-11 to 8.8e-10 GeV^-1 at 95% CL) where photon-ALP mixing resolves the tension between CIBER cosmic IR background measurements and observed TeV gamma-ray spectra from blazars H2356-309 and 1ES1101-232. This is a hinted/favored parameter region, not a new exclusion limit or sensitivity projection, so no exclusion data points are emitted. The only exclusion quoted (g_agamma < 8.8e-11 GeV^-1) is the pre-existing CAST bound, not a new result. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: The only (m_a, g_agamma) plot is Fig. 5. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: Fig. 5 shows contours of the ALLOWED region at 95% C.L. (inside contour the CIBER IR-background vs TeV gamma-ray tension is solved), not a standard exclusion region with 'excluded above'. I traced the outer thick blue 'CIBER only' contour (CIBER + Franceschini-Th), following its full lower/side boundary as a path: down the left edge (m ~ 1e-9 eV), along the flat bottom at g ~ 1.5e-11 GeV^-1 (Hillas-condition boundary), up the right side including the notch below the CAST line near m ~ 6e-9 to 7.5e-8 eV, then up to g = 1e-9 at m ~ 3e-7 eV. The horizontal CAST line at g = 8.8e-11 GeV^-1 (excluded above, per text) provides absolute y-calibration. The inner red contour (CIBER+IRTS+AKARI) lies slightly inside the blue one and was not traced.
